defects.justification: writeJSON discards the json.Encode error, so write/encode failures on every response go unlogged.
Error from deleting an expired token is ignored (a.db.Exec result discarded); DB failures here are invisible.
The expired-token purge in issueToken ignores the db.Exec error; a failing purge silently lets the tokens table grow without bound.

Fixed-window limiter resets at window boundaries, so a user can make ~120 requests within a few seconds straddling a boundary, exceeding the stated 60 requests/minute. Documented as fixed-window in README; would ask for a sliding window/token bucket rather than block.
